mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_CALL_LOG ( EXTERNAL_API_ID, EXECUTION_ID, FIRE_INSTANCE_ID, ATTEMPT_NO, STARTED_AT, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{externalApiId}, #{executionId}, #{fireInstanceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attemptNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_CALL_LOG SET HTTP_STATUS = #{httpStatus, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FINISHED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, RUN_MILLIS = #{runMillis, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, STATUS = #{status}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE API_CALL_LOG_ID = #{apiCallLogId}
mapper.select: SELECT L.API_CALL_LOG_ID, L.EXTERNAL_API_ID, L.EXECUTION_ID, A.API_NAME, L.FIRE_INSTANCE_ID, L.ATTEMPT_NO, L.HTTP_STATUS, L.STARTED_AT, L.FINISHED_AT, L.RUN_MILLIS, L.STATUS, L.ERROR_MESSAGE, L.CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_CALL_LOG L LEFT JOIN SCHED_EXTERNAL_API A ON L.EXTERNAL_API_ID = A.EXTERNAL_API_ID WHERE L.EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} ORDER BY L.ATTEMPT_NO
